title: Plantworks job record (v1)
description: What the broker returns for a job (POST /plantworks/v1/jobs, GET /plantworks/v1/jobs/{jobId}, POST .../cancel). See fork/src/broker/README.md.

class.description: The resolved class: the envelope's class, or the team spec's defaultClass.

priority.description: The effective priority stored at submit: the class's priority plus the envelope's offset. claim-next takes the lowest first, and a worker sends it to the endpoint (PW-29). Additive and fork-defined, pending the HarnessHG ack, as for the D11 fields.

detail.description: The PW-09 transition detail for the current state, for example {"reason": "front-door"} when cancelled. {} for states without detail.

reportWanted.description: W4-A, fork-defined: present while the seat has closed a running job and the broker waits for the worker's report on that closure (POST .../report); absent otherwise.

result.description: null until a worker reports a terminal result (PW-21).

oneOf.description: W4-A: a file the worker's report lists, as the D11 event carries it (git:<commit>:<path>).

usage.description: W4-A: worker-reported token usage, or null when unknown.

snapshot.description: W4-A: the worker's artifacts report as sent: {branch, commit, files, observedBy} or {branch: null, skipped, observedBy}.

reportProvenance.description: W4-A: usage and artifacts are the worker's word; the broker can't check a commit in the seat's repository.

report.description: W4-A: the worker's report was stored before done, or the wait ran out without one.

handoff.description: PW-34, fork-defined: for a done with closure handoff-sre, what plantworks.handoff.requested carries. The artifact with the mapped agent's slackApp reference name, or why there is none.
